channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage
item.description: The company is said to be significantly dropping the amount it's spending on AI for its engineering teams.

item.title: Canadian professor warns massive new data center would release ‘23 Hiroshima-sized atomic bombs worth of energy’ every day
item.description: Building Kevin O’Leary’s giant data center would release the equivalent energy of 23 nukes every day.

item.title: After the midterms, a bigger clash over data centers could be coming
item.description: Data center opposition crossed party lines in Tuesday’s midterms.

item.title: I spent a morning with Meta VR Glasses and wish I never had to take them off
item.description: Meta VR Glasses are shaping up to be the mixed-reality wearables we wanted all along, and my test drive made me a believer.

item.title: X says its updated web app is way faster
item.description: X is introducing a new version of its web app that it says is much faster than before, and it's now rolling out the updated app "one country at a time" for signed-in users. "Open a profile on X.com over a slow connection," principal engineer Yagiz Nizipli said in a blog post about the changes. […]

item.title: Tiny's new AI workstation is anything but — packing in 16 TB SSD array and 128 GB GPU memory, but with an eye-watering price tag to boot
item.description: Tiny Corp's new $30,000 tinybox swaps DRAM for sixteen SSDs to run a 2.8-trillion-parameter model at home.
